name: Edge-Radar: Next-Day Scan + Execute
description: Scans tomorrow's games the night before, to catch early lines; not every market is posted yet. Starts in preview: no orders until you set Mode to execute, and even then only when DRY_RUN=false in your .env. In execute mode it places REAL Kalshi orders, Kelly-sized, through every risk gate (daily loss limit, exposure caps, per-event limits). Read docs/setup/AUTOMATION_GUIDE.md first. Default 01:00 UTC (9 PM US Eastern in summer). Needs a clone of ai-automation-tools/edge-radar on the machine the task runs on, with its .venv and a .env holding your Kalshi and Odds API keys (python scripts/doctor.py checks both).

parameters.label: Edge-Radar clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your clone, e.g. C:\Users\you\edge-radar. Its .venv and .env are used.

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.help: preview saves the report and places no orders. execute places real Kalshi orders (only when DRY_RUN=false in .env).
